a: Gemara manni matnitin — rabbi meir hi, dei rabbi yehuda — la shane leh "korban" vela shane leh "hakkorban".
Ema sefa: "lakkorban lo ochal lach" — muttar. vehatnan: "lakkorban lo ochal lach" — rabbi meir oser, veamar rabbi abba: naasa keomer: "lakkorban yehe, lefichach lo ochal lach".
La kashya: ha deamar "lakkorban", ha deamar "la lekorban" — dela have korban kaamar.
Mishna shevua lo ochal lach, ha shevua sheochal lach, la shevua lo ochal lach — asur.

Gemara mikkelal deha shevua sheochal lach — dela achelna mashma. ureminhu: shevuot shetayim shehen arba. sheochal veshello ochal, sheachalti veshello achalti. middekaamar shello ochal, sheachalti veshello achalti, mikkelal desheochal lach — deachelna mashma!

Amar abbaye: "sheochal" shete leshonot mashma. hayu mesarvin bo leechol, veamar: "achelna achelna", vetu: "shevua sheochal" — deachelna mashma. aval amar: "la achelna la achelna", vetu amar: "shevua sheochal" — "dela achelna" kaamar.
Rav ashe amar: "sheochal" dishvua — "shei ochal" kaamar. im ken, peshita! may lememra? mahu detema: mekam lishshana hi deittekil leh, ka mashma lan.
Abbaye la amar taam kerav ashe — dela katane "shei ochal".

Verav ashe nade min taam deabbaye. kasavar "shello ochal" name, mashma shete leshonot. hayu mesarvin bo leechol veamar: "la achelna la achelna", veamar name: "shevua", ben "sheochal" ben "shello ochal" — haden "achelna" mashma deamar.
Veikka letarotza name lishshana "shevua shello ochal" — "shevua dela achelna" kaamar. ella tanna paska: "sheochal" — "deachelna" mashma, veshello ochal" — "lo ochal" mashma.

Mishna ze chomer bashshevuot mibbannedarim, vechomer bannedarim mibbashshevuot. ketzad? amar: "kuvnnam sukka sheani ose", "lulav sheani notel", "tefillin sheani manniach" — bannedarim asur, bashshevuot muttar, sheen nishbain laavor al hammitzvot.
b: Gemara "chomer", mikkelal deneder hu. veha "muttar" katane!
Assefa deiddach bava katane. "shevua sheeni yashen", "sheeni medabber", "sheeni mehallech" — asur. ze chomer bashshevuot mibbannedarim.

Chomer bannedarim mibbashshevuot ketzad kulei. rav kahana matne: amar rav giddel amar rav. verav tavyome matne: amar rav giddel amar shemuel. minnayin sheen nishbain laavor al hammitzvot? talmud lomar: "lo yachel devaro", "devaro lo yachel" — aval mechel hu lecheftze shamayim.
May shena neder — dichtiv: "ish ki yiddor neder laAdonai ... lo yachel devaro". shevua name, ha ketiv: "o hishshava shevua laAdonai lo yachel devaro"!
Amar abbaye: ha deamar "hanaat sukka alay", ha deamar "shevua shello ehene min hassukka".
Amar rava: vechi mitzvot lehanot nittenu? ella, amar rava: ha deamar "yeshivat sukka alay", veha deamar "shevua shello eshev bassukka".
Vesheen nishbain laavor al hammitzvot mehacha nafka leh? mehatam nafka leh, detanya: yachol nishba levattel et hammitzva velo bittel, yachol yehe chayyayv —

a: Talmud lomar: "lehara o lehetiv". ma hatava reshut, af haraa reshut. yatza nishba levattel et hammitzva velo bittel — sheen harshut beyado!
Chad kera lemiftereh mikkorban shevua, vechad lemiftereh min lav dishvua.

Mishna yesh neder betoch neder, veen shevua betoch shevua. ketzad? amar: "hareni nazir im ochal", "hareni nazir im ochal", veachal — chayyayv al kol achat veachat. "shevua shello ochal", "shevua shello ochal", veachal — eno chayyayv ella achat.

Gemara amar rav huna: lo shanu ella deamar "hareni nazir hayyom" "hareni nazir lemachar", demiggo deka mittosaf yoma yattira — chayyla nezirut al nezirut. aval amar "hareni nazir hayyom", "hareni nazir hayyom" — en chala nezirut al nezirut. ushemuel amar: afillu amar: "hareni nazir hayyom", "hareni nazir hayyom" — chala nezirut aleh.

Ulerav huna, additna en shevua betoch shevua, litne: yesh neder betoch neder, veen neder betoch neder. "hareni nazir hayyom, hareni nazir lemachar" — yesh neder betoch neder, "hareni nazir hayyom" "hareni nazir hayyom" —
b: En neder betoch neder! kashya.

Tenan: yesh neder betoch neder, veen shevua betoch shevua. hechi dame? ilema deamar "hareni nazir hayyom, hareni nazir lemachar", dichvota gabbe shevua: "shello ochal teenim", vechazar veamar "shevua shello ochal anavim" — ammay la chala shevua al shevua?

Ella hechi dame dela chala shevua al shevua, kegon deamar "shevua shello ochal teenim", vechazar veamar "shevua shello ochal teenim", dichvota gabbe nezirut hechi dame — deamar "hareni nazir hayyom, hareni nazir hayyom", vekatane yesh neder betoch neder. kashya lerav huna!

Amar lecha rav huna: matnitin deamar "hareni nazir hayyom, hareni nazir lemachar". dichvota gabbe shevua, deamar: "shello ochal teenim", vechazar veamar: "shevua shello ochal teenim vaanavim", dela chayyla.

Vehaamar rabba: "shevua shello ochal teenim", vechazar veamar: "shevua shello ochal teenim vaanavim", veachal teenim, vehifrish korban, vechazar veachal anavim — havya lehu anavim chatzi shiur, veen meviim korban al chatzi shiur.
Alma hecha deamar: "shevua shello ochal teenim", vechazar veamar "shevua shello ochal teenim vaanavim", miggo dechal shevua al anavim — chayyla name al teenim! rav huna la sevira leh kerabba.
Metivi: mi shennazar shete nezirot, mana et harishona vehifrish korban, venishal aleha, alta lo sheniyya barishona.
Hechi dame? ilema deamar "hareni nazir hayyom, hareni nazir lemachar" — ammay alta lo sheniyya barishona, ha ikka yoma yattira? ella peshita deamar "hareni nazir hayyom, hareni nazir hayyom".

a: Uteyuveta derav huna!
La, leolam "hareni nazir hayyom, hareni lemachar", umay "alta lo" — levar mehahu yoma yattira. i name, kegon shekkibbel shete nezirut bevat achat.

Metiv rav hamenuna: "nazir lehazzir" — mikkan shehannezirut chal al hannezirut. sheyyachol, vahalo din hu: uma shevua chamura — en shevua chala al shevua, nezirut kalla lo kol shekken — talmud lomar: nazir lehazzir, mikkan shehannezirut chala al hannezirut.
Hechi dame? ilema deamar "hareni nazir hayyom, hareni nazir lemachar", ha kera baaya?! ella lav: deamar "hareni nazir hayyom, hareni nazir hayyom" — vekatane nezirut chal al nezirut!
La, hacha bemay askinan — kegon shekkibbel alav shete nezirut bevat achat.
Umay chumera dishvua minneder? illema mishshum dechayyla afillu al davar sheen bo mammash, neder name chamur, shekken chal al hammitzva kirshut. ella — mishshum dichtiv bah bishvua: "lo yenakke".

"Shevua shello ochal, shevua shello ochal", veachal — eno chayyayv ella achat. amar rava: im nishal al harishona — sheniyya chala alav. mimmay — middela katane "eno ella achat", vekatane "eno chayyayv ella achat", ravvcha hu delet la. ki mitteshil al chaverta — chayyla.
Lishshana acharina: chiyyuva hu delekka, ha shevua ikka. lemay hilcheta? lechidrava. deamar rava: nishal al harishona — alta lo sheniyya tachteha.
Lema mesayyay leh: mi shennadar shete nezirot umana et harishona, vehifrish korban venishal aleha — alta lo sheniyya barishona.
Kegon shekkibbel alav shete nezirot bevat achat.
b: Mishna setam nedarim lehachamir, uferusham lehakel. ketzad? amar "hare alay kevasar maliach" "keyen nesech", im beshel shelamim nadar — asur.
Im beshel avoda zara nadar — muttar. veim setam — asur.
"Hare alay kecherem", im kecherem shel shamayim — asur, veim kecherem shel kohanim — muttar. veim setam — asur.
"Hare alay kemaaser", im kemasar behema nadar — asur. veim shel goren, — muttar. veim setam — asur.
"Hare alay kitruma", im kitrumat hallishka nadar — asur. veim shel goren — muttar. veim setam — asur. divre rabbi meir.

Rabbi yehuda omer: setam teruma, bihuda — asura, baggalil — mutteret, sheen anshe galil makkirin et terumat hallishka. setam charamim, bihuda — muttarin, baggalil — asurin, sheen anshe galil makkirin et cherme hakkohanim.
Gemara vehatnan: sefek nezirut lehakel?
Amar rabbi zera, la kashya: ha rabbi eliezer, ha rabbanan. detanya: hammakdish chayyayto uvehemto — hikdish et hakkoy. rabbi eliezer omer: lo hikdish et hakkoy.
Man deamar mamono meayyel lisfeka, gufeh name meayyel. uman deamar mamono la meayyel lisfeka, gufeh (name)

a: Kol shekken dela meayyel lisfeka.
Amar leh abbaye: bemay okemta lisfek nezirut lehakel — kerabbi eliezer, ema sefa: sefek bechorot, echad bechore adam veechad bechore vehema, ben temea ben tehora — hammotzi mechavero alav haraya.
Vetane ala: vaasurim begizza vaavoda!
Amar leh: ammay ka medammet kedushsha habbaa meeleha, likdushsha habbaa bide adam?
Ella i kashya, ha kashya: sefek mashkin, littame — tame, letamme acherim — tahor, divre rabbi meir, vechen haya rabbi elazar omer kidvarav.
Umi sevira leh lerabbi eliezer littame tame?
Vehatanya, rabbi eliezer omer: en tumea lemashkin kol ikkar. teda: shehare heid yose ben yoezer ish tzereda al ayyal kamtza dechan, veal mashkin bet mitbechayya dechan?
Hanicha lishmuel, deamar: dechan milletamme acherim, aval tumeat atzman yesh bahen, shappir.
Ella lerav deamar dechan mammash, may ikka lememar?
Ella: ha rabbi yehuda, veha rabbi shimon.
Detanya: "hareni nazir im yesh bichri hazze mea kor", vehalach umetzao shennignav o sheavad — rabbi yehuda mattir, verabbi shimon oser.

Verame derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda: mi amar rabbi yehuda la meayyel inish nafsheh lisfeka? ureminhi, rabbi yehuda omer: setam teruma bihuda — asura, uvaggalil — mutteret, sheen anshe haggalil makkirin et terumat hallishka. tama deen makkirin,
b: Ha makkirin — asurin!
Amar rava: gabbe keri kasavar kol shessefeko chamur mivvadday — la meayyel nafsheh lisfeka, deillu gabbe nazir vadday, megalleach umevi korban veneechol. al sefeko, la matze megallach.
Amar leh rav huna bar yehuda lerava: amar "hareni nezir olam", may?
Amar leh: nezir olam name sefeko chamur mivvadday, deillu vadday hichbid searo — mekel betaar, umevi shalosh behemot. veillu sefeko — lo.
Amar "hareni nezir shimshon" may?
Amar leh: nezir shimshon la tanya. amar leh: vehaamar rav adda bar ahava: tanya nezir shimshon! amar leh: i tanya — tanya.
Rav ashe amar: hahi — rabbi yehuda mishshum rabbi tarfon hi. detanya, rabbi yehuda mishshum rabbi tarfon omer: en echad mehem nazir — lefi shello nittena nezirut ella lehafelaa.
I hachi may irya shennignav o sheavad? ella, lehodiacha kocho derabbi shimon, deaf al gav denignav o sheavad, kasavar meayyel inish nafsheh lisfeka.
Rabbi yehuda omer: setam teruma bihuda kulei. ha makkirin — asurin, alma sefeka lechumera.
Ema sefa: setam charamim bihuda — muttarin, uvaggalil — asurin, sheen anshe haggalil makkirin et cherme hakkohanim. ha makkirin — muttarin. alma sefeka lekulla!
Amar abbaye: sefa rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok hi. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: setam teruma bihuda — asura, rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer: setam charamim baggalil — asurin.

a: Mishna nadar becherem, veamar: lo nadarti ella bechermo shel yam. bekorban, veamar: lo nadarti ella bekorbanot shel melachim.
"Hare atzmi korban", veamar: lo nadarti ella beetzem shehinnachti li lihyot noder bo, "kuvnnam ishti nehenet li", veamar: lo nadarti ella beishti harishona sheggerashti —
Al kullan en nishalin lahem. veim nishalu — onshin otan umachmirin alehen. divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: potchin lahen petach mimmakom acher, umelammedin otan — kede shello yinhagu kallut rosh bindarim.
Gemara ha gufa kashya, amrat: en nishalin lahen, vahadar tane: im nishalu onshin otan umachmirin alehen?
Amar rav yehuda, hachi katane: vechullan en tzerichin sheela, bamme devarim amurim — betalmid chacham, aval beam haaretz shebba lishshael — onshin oto umachmirin alav.
Bishlama machmirin — dela patchinan leh bacharata, ella onshin hechi dame?

Kidtanya: mi shennazar veavar al neziruto — en nizkakin lo ad sheyyinhog bo issur kayyamim shennahag bahen hetter. divre rabbi yehuda. amar rabbi yose: bamme devarim amurim — binzirut muetet. aval binzirut merubba — dayyo sheloshim yom.
Amar rav yosef: hoil veamri rabbanan en nizkakim lo, be dina demizdakki la aved shappir. rav acha bar yaakov omer: meshammetinan leh.

Vachachamim omrim potchin lo petach kulei. tana: leolam al tehi ragil bannedarim, shessofcha limol bishvuot. veal tehi ragil etzel am haaretz, shessofcha lehaachilcha tevalim. al tehi ragil etzel kohen am haaretz, shessofcha lehaachilcha teruma. veal tarbe sicha im haishsha, shessofcha lavo lide niuf.

Rabbi acha berabbi yoshiyya omer: kol hatztzofe benashim, sofo ba lide avera. vechol hammistakkel baakevah shel ishsha, havyin lo banim sheenan mehugganin. amar rav yosef: uveishto nidda. amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: akevah dekatane, bimkom hattinnofet, shehu mechuuon keneged heakev.

Tanya: "baavur tihye yirato al penechem" — zo busha. "levilti techetau" — melammed shehabbusha mevia lide yirat chet. mikkan amru: siman yafe beadam shehu bayyshan. acherim omrim: kol adam hammitbayyesh, lo bimhera hu chote. umi sheen lo boshet panim — beyadua shello amdu avotav al har sinay.

Amar rabbi yochanan ben dahavay, arbaa devarim sachu li malache hashsharet: chiggerin mippene ma havyin — mippene shehofchim et shulechanam. illemim mippene ma havyin — mippene shemmenashshekim al oto makom. chershim mippene ma havyin — mippene shemsapperim bishat tashmish. somin mippene ma havyin — mippene shemmistakkelim beoto makom.
Ureminhu, shaalu et imma shalom: mippene ma
b: Banayich yefefin beyoter? amra lahen: eno mesapper immi lo bitchillat hallayla, velo besof hallayla, ella bachatzot hallayla. ucheshehu mesapper, megalle tefach umechasse tefach, vedome alav kemi shekkefao shed.
Veamarti lo: ma taam? veamar li: kede shello etten et enay beishsha acheret, venimtzeu banav bain lide mamzerut.
La kashya: ha — bemille detashmish, ha — bemille achranyayta.

Amar rabbi yochanan: zo divre yochanan ben dahavay, aval amru chachamim: en halacha keyochanan ben dahavay, ella kol ma sheadam rotze laasot beishto — ose. mashal levasar habba mibbet hattabbach, ratza leochlo bemelach — ochlo. tzali — ochlo. mevushshal — ochlo. shaluk — ochlo. vechen dag habba mibbet hatztzayyayd.

Amar ammemar: man malache hashsharet — rabbanan, dei tema malache hashsharet mammash, ammay amar rabbi yochanan en halacha keyochanan ben dahavay? ha inhu bekii betzurat havvalad tefe! veammay karu lehu malache hashsharet — dimtzayyeyni kemalache hashsharet.

Hahi daatay lekammeh derabbi, amra lo: rabbi, arachti lo shulechan vahafacho! amar lah: bitti, tora hittiratech, vaani ma eese lich? hahi daatay lekammeh derav, amra lo: rabbi, arachti lo shulechan vahafacho! amar: may shena min binita?
"Velo taturu achare levavchem", mikkan amar rabbi: al yishte adam bechos ze veyitten enav bechos acher. amar ravina: lo nitzrecha, ella daafillu shete nashav.
"Uvaroti mikkem hammordim vehapposhim bi", amar rabbi levi: ellu bene tesha middot, bene osna"400 meshugga"8.
Bene ema, bene anusa, bene senua, bene nidduy, bene temura, bene meriva, bene shichrut, bene gerushat hallev, bene irbuveya, bene chatzufa.

Ini? vehaamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol adam sheishto tovato — havyin lo banim sheafillu bedoro shel moshe rabbenu lo hayu kemotam. shenneemar: "havu lachem anashim chachamim unevonim", uchetiv: "vaekkach et rashe shivtechem", vela ketiv "nevonim".
Uchetiv "yissashchar chamor garem", uchetiv: "mibbene yissashchar yode vina laittim"!
Hahi demartzeya artzoye.
Hadaran alach veellu muttarin

Arbaa nedarim hittiru chachamim: nidre zeruzin, venidre havay, venidre shegagot, venidre onasin. nidre zeruzin ketzad? haya mocher chefetz, veamar: "kuvnnam sheeni pochet lecha min hassela", vehalla omer: "kuvnnam sheeni mosif lach al hashshekel",

a: Shenehem rotzin bishlosha dinarin.

Gemara arbaa nedarim hittiru chachamim kulei. amar leh rabbi abba bar memel lerabbi amme: amart lan mishshemeh derabbi yehuda nesia: man tena arbaa nedarim — rabbi yehuda hi, deamar mishshum rabbi tarfon: leolam en echad mehen nazir, lefi shello nittena nezirut ella lehafelaa.
Rava amar: afillu tema rabbanan, mi katane "shenehen ratzu"? "shenehen rotzin" katane.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: amar lo tefe missela, vehalla omer betzir mishshekel, nidra have, o zeruzin have?

Amar leh, tenena: haya mesarev bachavero sheyyochal etzlo, veamar lo "kuvnnam betcha sheani nichnas", "tippat tzonen sheani toem" — muttar likkanes leveto velishtot hemennu tzonen, shello nitkavvevn ze ella leshum achila ushetiyya.
Veammay? veha "tippat tzonen" kaamar! ella mishtae inish hachi. hacha name mishtae inish hachi.
Amar leh:
b: Mi dame? gabbe tzonen, tzaddikim omrim meat veosin harebe —
Hacha sefeka hu, dilma pachot missela veyoter al shekel kaamar, vezeruzin have, o dilma davka kaamar, venidra have. tibbee.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav assi: arbaa nedarim hallalu tzerichin sheela lechacham. ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar: tanna tane "arbaa nedarim hittiru chachamim", veat amrat tzerichin sheela lechacham?!
Rav yosef matni la leha shemata behay lishshana: amar rav yehuda amar rav assi: en chacham rashshay lehattir ella keen arbaa nedarim hallalu. kasavar en potchin bacharata.
Hahu daata lekammeh derav huna, amar leh: libbach alach? amar leh: la, vesharyeh.
Hahu daata lekammeh derabba bar rav huna, amar leh: illu hayu asara bene adam sheyyefayyeysuch beotah shaa mi nadarta? amar leh: lo, vehittiro.

Tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: omrim lo laadam: lev ze alecha? im amar "lav" — mattirin oto. rabbi yishmael berabbi yose omer mishshum aviv: omrim lo laadam: illu hayu asara bene adam sheyyefayyeysuch beotah shaa mi nadarta? im amar "lav" — mattirin oto.
(Siman: assi veelazar, yochanan veyannay).

Hahu daata lekammeh derabbi assi amar leh: kedu tahet? amar leh: la, vesharyeh. hahu daata lekammeh derabbi elazar, amar leh: baet nadur? amar leh: illu la margezin li la baenan kelum. amar leh: tehe kevaet. hahi itteta deaddarta livratta, atay lekammeh derabbi yochanan, amar la: illu hava yadat deamran megeratich ala divrattich:

a: Illu la chamat bah imma millin daaziva — bichdi la addarta! mi addarta? amara leh: la, vesharyay.
Bar beratte derabbi yannay sava ata lekammeh derabbi yannay sava, amar leh: illu hava yadat defatchin pinkesach umemashmeshin beovadach, mi nedart? amar leh: la, vesharyeh.
Amar rabbi abba: may keraa — "veachar nedarim levakker". veaf al gav diftach rabbi yannay leh — anan la patchinan leh beha.

Vela patchinan behada achraniyta, deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: may petach leh rabban gamliel lehahu sava: "yesh bote kemadkerot charev uleshon chachamim marpe". kol habbote — rauy ledokro becherev, ella — leshon chachamim marpe.

Vela patchinan bahada achraniyta, detanya, rabbi natan omer: hannoder — keillu bana bama, vehamekayyeymo — keillu makriv alav korban. beresha patchinan. besefa, abbaye amar: patchinan, rava amar: la patchinan.

Rav kahana matne la leha shemata behaden lishshana. rav tavyome matne hachi: besefa la patchinan. beresha, abbaye amar: patchinan, rava amar: la patchinan. vehilcheta: la patchinan la beresha vela besefa.

Vela patchinan beha name dishmuel. deamar shemuel: af al pi shemmekayyeymo — nikra rasha. amar rabbi avahu, may kera: "vechi techdal lindor lo yihye vecha chet", veyalef "chadala" "chadala". ketiv hacha: "vechi techdal lindor", uchetiv hatam: "sham reshaim chadlu rogez".
Amar rav yosef, af anan name tenena: "kenidre chesherim" — lo amar kelum, "kenidre reshaim" — nadar benazir uvekorban uvishvua.

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol hakkoes kol mine gehinnam sholtin bo, shenneemar: "vehaser kaas millibbecha vehaaver raa mibbesarecha", veen "raa" ella gehinnam, shenneemar: "kol paal Adonai lammaanehu vegam rasha leyom raa".

Velo od ella shehattachtoniyyot sholtot bo, shenneemar: "venatan Adonai lecha sham lev raggaz vechilyon enayim vedaavon nafesh", ezehu davar shemmechalle et haenayim umadiv et hannefesh — heve omer: ellu hattachtoniyyot.

Ulla bemissekeh leara deyisrael itlevo leh teren bene chozae bahadeh. kam chad shachteh lechavreh. amar leh leulla: yaut avadi? amar leh: in, ufera leh bet hashshechita. ki ata lekammeh derabbi yochanan, amar leh: dilma chas veshalom achziki yede ovre avera? amar leh: nafshecha hitztzalta.
Ka tama rabbi yochanan, mikkedi ketiv: "venatan Adonai lecha sham lev raggaz" bevavel ketiv? amar leh: hahu shata
b: La avrinan yardena.

Amar rabba bar rav huna: kol hakkoes, afillu shechina enah chashuva kenegdo, shenneemar: "rasha kegova appo bal yidrosh en elohim kol mezimmotav". rabbi yirmeya middifti amar: meshakkeach talmudo umosif tippeshut, shenneemar: "ki chaas bechek kesilim yanuach", uchetiv: "uchesil yifros ivvelet". rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: beyadua sheavonotav merubbin mizzechiyyotav, shenneemar: "uvaal chema rav pasha".
Amar rav adda berabbi chanina: ilmale (lo) chatu yisrael lo nittan lahem ella chamishsha chumeshe tora vesefer yehoshua bilvad, sheerkah shel eretz yisrael hu. may tama: "ki berov chochma rov kaas".
Amar rabbi assi: en nizkakin leelohe yisrael", chutz mikkunnam ishti nehenet li shegganva et kisi veshehikketa et beni", venoda shello ganva veshello hikkattu.

Hahi daatay lekammeh derav assi, amar la: bemay nedart? belohe yisrael". amar la: i nedart bemohi" shehi kinnuy bealma — mizdekikna lich, hasheta dela nedart bemohi ella belohe yisrael", la mizdekikna lich.

Rav kahana ikkela leve rav yosef, amar leh: litom mar midde. amar leh: la mare kolla, la taemna leh. amar leh: la mare kolla, la taaymat leh. hanicha lerav kahana, deamar: "la mare kolla". ella lerav yosef, ammay amar "la mare kolla"? hachi hu dekaamar leh: "la mare kolla" hu dekaamrat, hilkach la taaymat leh.
Amar rava amar rav nachman: hilcheta, potchin bacharata, venizkakin lelohe yisrael".
Mishtabbach leh rava lerav nachman berav sechora deadam gadol hu. amar lo: kesheyyavo leyadcha, haviehu leyadi. hava leh nidra lemishre. ata lekammeh derav nachman.
Amar leh: nedart addata dehachi? amar leh: in. addata dehachi? in. kamma zimnin. ikkefad rav nachman. amar leh: zil lekilach.

Nefak rav sechora ufetach pitcha lenafsheh. rabbi omer: eze hi derech yeshara sheyyavor lo haadam. kol shehi tiferet leoseha vetiferet lo min haadam. vehasheta deikkefad rav nachman — addata dehachi la nedari. ushera lenafsheh.
Rabbi shimon berabbi hava leh nidra lemishre. ata lekammayyhu derabbanan, amri leh: nedart addata dehachi? amar: in. addata dehachi? in. kamma zimnin,

a: Vahavo mitztaari rabbanan mishshimsha letulla umittulla leshimsha.
(Lishshana achara: addata dehachi? in. kamma zimnin, vahavo mitztaari rabbanan mishshimsha letulla umittulla leshimsha.)
Amar leh batnit bereh deabba shaul ben batnit: mi nedart addata demitztaari rabbanan mittulla leshimsha umishshimsha letulla? amar: la, vesharyu.

Rabbi yishmael bar rabbi yose hava leh nidra lemishre. ata lekammayyhu derabbanan, amru leh: nedart addata dehachi? amar lehu: in. nedarta addata dehachi? amar lehu: in. kamma zimnin. kevan dachaza hahu katztzara demitztaari rabbanan, machyeh beuchela dekatztzare. amar: addata demache li katztzara la nedari, vesharye lenafsheh.
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: hay nolad hu, dela massek addata demache leh katztzara. utenena: en potchin lo bannolad! amar leh: hay lav nolad hu, dishchichi appikore dimtzaari rabbanan.

Devethu deabbaye hava la hahi beratta. hu amar: lekarivay. hi amra: lekariva. amar la: tittesar hanaati alach i avrat addatay umaynssevat la lekarivach. azalat vaavarat al dateh veinnasva lekariva. ata lekammeh derav yosef. amar leh: illu hava yadat daavarat al datach umanseva la lekariva mi addarta? amar: la. vesharyeh rav yosef.

Umi shere ki hay gavvna? in, vehatanya: maase beadam echad shehiddir et ishto millaalot laregel, veavra al dato vealta laregel, uva lifne rabbi yose. amar lo: veillu hayita yodea sheoveret al datecha veola laregel kelum hiddartah? amar lo: lo, vehittiro rabbi yose.
Mishna rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: af harotze lehaddir et chavero sheyyochal etzlo, yomar lo: "kol neder sheani atid liddor hu batel", uvilvad sheyyehe zachur bishat hanneder.
Gemara vechevan deamar "kol neder sheani atid liddor yehe batel", la shama leh vela ate bahadeh?
b: Chassore michassera vehachi katane: harotze sheyyochal etzlo chavero umesarev bo umaddiro — nidre zeruzin hu. veharotze shello yitkayyeymu nedarav kol hashshana, yaamod berosh hashshana veyomar: kol neder sheani atid liddor yehe batel, uvilvad sheyyehe zachur bishat hanneder.
I zachur, akreh litnaeh, vekayyem leh lenidreh! amar abbaye, tane: uvilvad shello yehe zachur bishat hanneder.

Rava amar: leolam kidamrinan meikkara. hacha bemay askinan — kegon shehitna berosh hashshana, velo yada bamme hitna. vehasheta ka nadar. i zachur bishat hanneder, veamar "al daat harishona ani noder" — nidreh let beh mammasha. lo amar "al daat harishona ani noder" — akreh litnaeh vekayyem lenidreh.
Rav huna bar chinnana savar lemidresheh befirka. amar leh rava: tanna ka mesattem la sattome kede shello yinhagu kallut rosh bindarim, veat darshat leh befirka?!
Ibbaya lehu: peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer ben yaakov, o la? veim timtza lomar peligi, hilcheta kevateh, o la? ta shema, ditnan: haomer lachavero

a: "Kuvnnam sheeni nehene lecha im i atta notel levincha kor shel chittin ushete chaviyyot shel yayin", hare ze yachol lehattir et nidro shello al pi chacham, sheyyachol lomar lo: kelum amarta ella bishvil kevodi — ze hu kevodi.
Tama deamar "ze hu kevodi", ha lav hachi — neder hu. manni? i rabbi eliezer ben yaakov — nidre zeruzin have. ella shema minna: peligi rabbanan aleh.
Leolam rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi, umode rabbi eliezer ben yaakov behay denidra have, deamar leh: la kalba ana, demithanena minnach vela mithanet minnay.

Ta shema: haomer lachavero "kuvnnam sheatta nehenet li im i atta noten livni kor shel chittin ushete chaviyyot shel yayin", rabbi meir omer: ad sheyyitten. vachachamim omrim: af ze yachol lehattir et nidro shello al pi chacham, sheyyachol lomar: hareni keillu hitkabbalti.
Tama deamar "hareni keillu hitkabbalti", ha lav hachi — neder hu. manni? i rabbi eliezer ben yaakov — nidre zeruzin have, ella lav: rabbanan, ufeligi!
La, leolam rabbi eliezer ben yaakov, umode rabbi eliezer behay denidra have, mishshum deamar leh: lav malka ana, dimhannena lach veat la mehannet li.

Amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe, ta shema: nidre onasin, hiddiro chavero sheyyochal etzlo, vechala hu o chala beno o sheikkevo nahar. ha lav hachi — neder hu. manni? i rabbi eliezer ben yaakov — zeruzin have. ella lav: rabbanan, ufeligi!

Leolam rabbi eliezer ben yaakov, umi savrat deaddereh mezammena lizmina? la, dizmina addereh limzammena. daamar leh mezammenat li lisodtaych? amar leh: in. neder ze alecha? venadar. vechala hu o shechala beno o sheikkevo nahar — hare ellu nidre onasin.

Ta shema: yater al ken, amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: haomer lachavero "kuvnnam sheani nehene lach im i atta mitareach etzli vetochal immi pat chamma vetishte immi kos chammin", vehalla hikpid kenegdo — af ellu nidre zeruzin. velo hodu lo chachamim. may "lo hodu lo chachamim"? lav
b: Daafillu bekammayyta, ushema minna peligi rabbanan aleh. shema minna.
May have ala? ta shema, deamar rav huna: halacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov, vechen amar rav adda bar ahava: halacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov.
Mishna nidre havay, amar: "kuvnnam im lo raiti badderech hazze keole mitzrayim", "im lo raiti nachash kekorat bet habbad".
Gemara tana: nidre havay — muttarin, shavuot havay — asurin.
Hechi dame shavuot havay? ilema deamar "shevua im lo raiti badderech hazze" — middaam kaamar?!

Amar abbaye: deamar "shevua sheraiti". amar leh rava: im ken lema li lememar? veod: dumeya deneder katane! ella amar rava, beomer: "yeasru perot haolam alay bishvua im lo raiti badderech hazze keole mitzrayim".
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: vedilma hay gavra kinna deshumeshmane chaza veassek lehon shema "ole mitzrayim", veshappir mishteva?

a: Amar leh: ki mishteva — addata didan mishteva, vaanan la massekinan nafshin ashshumeshmane.

Veal data denafsheh la avid inish demishteva? vehatanya: keshehen mashbiin oto, omrim lo: heve yodea shello al tenay shebbelibbecha anu mashbiin otcha, ella al datenu veal daat bet din. leappoke may? lav leappoke deassek lehu leiskunedre veassek lehon shema zuze.
Umiddekaamar "al datenu", mikkelal daavid inash demishteva addata denafsheh!
La, leappoke mikkanya derava. dehahu gavra dahava massek bechavreh zuze, ata lekammeh derava. amar leh lelove: zil pera li. amar leh: peraticha. amar leh rava: im ken, zil ishteva leh difrateh.
Azal veayyti kanya, veyahev zuze begavveh, vahava mistemich veazel veate aleh leve dina. amar leh lemalve: nekot hay kanya bidach. nesav sefer tora veishteva defareh kol ma dahava leh bideh.
Hahu malve regaz vetavre lehahu kanya, veishtefuch hanhu zuze leara, veishtechach dekusheta ishteva.

Veakkatti la avid demishteva addata denafsheh? vehatanya: vechen matzinu bemoshe rabbenu keshehishbia et yisrael bearvot moav, amar lahem: hevu yodim shello al datechem ani mashbia etchem, ella al dati veal daat hammakom, shenneemar: "velo ittechem levaddechem vegomer".

"May amar lehu moshe leyisrael? lav hachi kaamar lehu: dilma avedtun mille, veamritun: al datenu — mishshum hachi amar lehu: al dati. leappoke may? lav leappoke deassiku shema laavoda zara eloah. mikkelal daavid inish demishteva addata denafsheh!
La, avoda zara ikkeri eloah, dichtiv: "uvechol elohe mitzrayim vegomer".
Velashba yathon dimkayyeymitun mitzvot! mashma mitzvot hammelech.
Velashba yathon dimkayyeymitun kol mitzvot! mashma mitzvat tzitzit, deamar mar: shekula mitzvat tzitzit keneged kol mitzvot shebbattora.

Velashba yathon dimkayyeymitun tora! mashma: tora achat. velashba yathon dimkayyeymitun torot! mashma: torat mincha, torat chattat, torat asham. velashba yathon dimkayyeymitun [torot] umitzvot! [torot] mashma: torat hammincha. mitzvot, mashma: mitzvot hammelech.
Velayshba yathon dimkayyeymitun tora kullah! tora kullah, mashma: avoda zara. detanya: chamura avoda zara, shekkol hakkofer bah — keillu mode battora kullah.
Velayshba yathon dimkayyeymitun avoda zara vetora kullah, i name: shesh meot ushelosh esre mitzvot! ella, moshe rabbenu milleta dela tericha nekat.

Im lo raiti nachash kekorat bet habbad, vela? veha hahu chivya dahava bishne shabbur malka, remo leh telesar uravota detivna uvela yathon! amar shemuel: betaruf, kullehu nachashe mitraf terifi! aggabbo taruf kaamrinan.

Velitne "taruf"? milleta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan, dekorat bet habbad gabbo taruf. lemay nafka minna? lemikkach umimkar, lomar lach: hammocher korat bet habbad lachavero, i gabbo taruf — in, vei la — la.
b: Mishna nidre shegagot — "im achalti veim shatiti", venizkar sheachal veshata. "sheani ochel vesheani shote", veshachach veachal veshata. amar: "kuvnnam ishti nehenet li shegganva et kisi, veshehikketa et beni", venoda shello hikkattu, venoda shello ganva.

Raa otan ochlin teenim, veamar: "hare alechem korban", venimtzeu aviv veachiv vehayu immahen acherim. bet shammay omrim: hen muttarim, uma sheimmahem — asurim. uvet hillel omrim: ellu vaellu muttarin.

Gemara tana: keshem shennidre shegagot muttarin, kach shevuot shegagot muttarot. hechi dame shevuot shegagot? kegon rav kahana verav assi, haden amar: shevuata dehachi amar rav, vehaden amar: shevuata dehachi amar rav. dechol chad vechad addata denafsheh shappir kamishteva.

Raa otan ochlin. tenan hatam: potchin beshabbatot uveyamim tovim. barishona hayu omrim: otan hayyamim — muttarim, ushear kol hayyamim — asurim, ad shebba rabbi akiva velimmed: neder shehuttar miktzato huttar kullo.

Amar rabba: dechulle alma, kol hecha deamar: illu hayiti yodea sheabba benechem, hayiti omer "kullechem asurin chutz meabba", dechullehon asurin veaviv muttar. lo nechleku ella beomer: illu hayiti yodea sheabba benechem, hayiti omer: "peloni ufeloni asurin veabba muttar".

a: Verava amar: dechulle alma, kol hecha deamar: illu hayiti yodea sheabba benechem hayiti omer: "peloni ufeloni asurin veabba muttar" — kullam muttarin. lo nechleku ella beomer: illu hayiti yodea sheabba benechem, hayiti omer: "kullechem asurin chutz meabba".
Bet shammay savri la kerabbi meir, deamar: tefos lashon rishon.
Uvet hillel savri la kerabbi yose, deamar: bigmar devarav adam nitpas.

Etiveh rav pappa lerava: ketzad amar rabbi akiva neder shehuttar miktzato huttar kullo? "kuvnnam sheeni nehene lechullechem", huttar echad mehen — hutteru kullam. "sheeni nehene lo laze velaze", huttar harishon — hutteru kullam, huttar haacharon — haacharon muttar vechullan asurin.
Bishlama lerabba, mokem le leresha, deamar laze velaze.
Vesefa — deamar "lechullechem".
Ella ledidach: bishlama resha mokem le deamar "lechullechem".
b: Ella sefa, deamar "laze velaze", rabbi akiva hi, ammay peligi rabbanan aleh? vehaamrat divre hakkol muttar!
Amar leh rava: ulerabba lerabbi akiva mi nicha sefa? bemay mokem le — deamar "lechullechem", he den hu rishon vehe den hu acharon?
Ella: resha deamar "lechullechem", vesefa, kegon shettelaan ze baze, veamar: "peloni kifloni, ufeloni kifloni".
Dayka name, detanya: huttar haemtzai — hemennu ulematta muttarin, ulemala — asurin.

Etiveh rav adda bar ahava lerava: "kuvnnam batzal sheani toem, shehabbatzal ra lallev". amru lo: vahalo hakkuferi yafe lallev! huttar bakkuferi. velo bakkuferi bilvad huttar, ella bechol habbetzalim. maase haya, vehittiro rabbi meir bechol habbetzalim.
May lav, deamar: illu hayiti yodea shehakkuferi yafe lallev, hayiti omer "kol habbetzalim asurin vechuferi muttar"?
Lo, beomer: illu hayiti yodea shehakkuferi yafe lallev, hayiti omer: "batzal peloni ufeloni asurin vechuferi muttar". verabbi meir allibba derabbi akiva veallibba derabbanan.
Etiveh ravina lerava: rabbi natan omer: yesh neder shemmiktzato muttar umiktzato asur. ketzad? nadar min hakkalkalla,

a: Vehayu bah benot shuach, veamar: "illu hayiti yodea shebbenot shuach betochah, lo hayiti noder" — hakkalkalla asura, benot shuach muttarot. ad shebba rabbi akiva velimmed: neder shehuttar miktzato — huttar kullo. may lav, deamar illu hayiti yodea shebbenot shuach betochah, hayiti omer "teenim shechorot ulevanot asurot, benot shuach muttarot", verabbi akiva hi, ufeligi rabbanan?
La, beomer: illu hayiti yodea shebbenot shuach betochah, hayiti omer: "kol hakkalkalla asura, uvenot shuach muttarot".
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan: nadar mechamishsha bene adam keechad, huttar leechad mehem — hutteru kullan. "chutz meechad mehen" — hu muttar, vehen asurin.
I lerabba, resha rabbi akiva vesefa divre hakkol. i lerava, sefa rabbanan veresha divre hakkol.
Mishna nidre onasin, hiddiro chavero sheyyochal etzlo, vechala hu o shechala beno o sheikkevo nahar — hare ellu nidre onasin.
Gemara hahu gavra deatpes zachvota beve dina, veamar: i la atena ad telatin yomin, libbatlun hane zachvotay. ittenis vela ata. amar rav huna: betil zachvoteh.
Amar leh rava: anus hu, veanus rachamana patreh, dichtiv: "velannaara lo taase davar".
Vechi tema ketala shane, vehatnan: nidre onasin, hiddiro chavero sheyyochal etzlo, vechala hu o shechala beno o sheikkevo nahar — hare ellu nidre onasin!
Ulerava, may shena meha ditnan: "hare ze gittech meachshav im lo bati mikkan ad shenem asar chodesh", umet betoch shenem asar chodesh — hare ze get. ammay? veha menas ittenis! amri: dilma shane hatam
b: Dei hava yada demit, min lealtar hava gamar veyahev gitta.
May shena mehahu daamar lehu: i la atena mikkan ad telatin yomin leheve gitta. ata ufaskeh mabara. amar lehu: chazo daatay, chazo daatay! vaamar shemuel: la shemeh metyay. ammay? veha menas anis!
Dilma unesa demiggalleya shane, umabara miggalle uneseh.
Ulerav huna, mikkedi asmachta hi. veasmachta la kanya! shane hacha demittafsan zachvateh.
Vehecha demittafsin lav asmachta hi? vehatnan: mi sheppara miktzat chovo, vehishlish et shetaro, veamar: im en ani noten lo mikkan ad sheloshim yom — ten lo shetaro.
Higgia zeman velo natan, rabbi yose omer: yitten. verabbi yehuda omer: lo yitten. veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu amar rav: en halacha kerabbi yose deamar asmachta kanya!
Shane hacha deamar libbatlan zachvateh.
Vehilcheta: asmachta kanya. vehu dela anis, vehu dikno minneh bevet din chashuv.
Mishna nodrin leharagin velecharamin velammochsin. shehi teruma, af al pi sheeno teruma. shehen shel bet hammelech, af al pi sheenan shel bet hammelech. bet shammay omrim: bakkol nodrin,

a: Chutz mibbishvua. uvet hillel omrim: af bishvua.
Bet shammay omrim: lo yiftach lo beneder, uvet hillel omrim: af yiftach lo. bet shammay omrim: bamme shehu maddiro. uvet hillel omrim: af bamme sheeno maddiro.
Ketzad? amar lo: emor "kuvnnam ishti nehenet li", veamar: "kuvnnam ishti uvanay nehenin li", bet shammay omrim: ishto mutteret uvanav asurin. uvet hillel omrim: ellu vaellu muttarin.
Gemara vehaamar shemuel: dina demalchuta dina?
Amar rav chinnana amar rav kahana amar shemuel: bemoches sheen lo kitzva. deve rabbi yannay amar: bemoches haomed meelav.
Shehen shel bet hammelech, veaf al pi sheenan shel bet hammelech. hechi nadar? amar rav amram amar rav: beomer "yeasru perot haolam alay im enan shel bet hammelech".
Kevan deamar "yeasru" — ittesaru aleh kol pere alma! beomer "hayyom". i deamar "hayyom" la mekabbel minneh moches!
Beomer belibbo "hayyom", umotzi bisfatav setam. veaf al gav disvira lan devarim shebballev enan devarim — legabbe onasin shane.

Bet shammay omrim: bakkol kulei. bet shammay omrim: bamme shehu maddiro, uvet hillel omrim: af besheeno maddiro. ketzad? amar lo: "kuvnnam ishti nehenet li", veamar "kuvnnam ishti uvanay nehenin li". bet shammay omrim: ishto mutteret uvanav asurin, uvet hillel omrim: ellu vaellu muttarin.

Amar rav huna: tana, bet shammay omrim: lo yiftach lo bishvua, uvet hillel omrim: af yiftach lo bishvua. levet shammay bishvua hu delo yiftach lo, ha beneder yiftach lo. veha tenan, bet shammay omrim: lo yiftach lo banneder!
Vetu: miftach hu dela yiftach lo bishvua, ha middar nadar bishvua. vehatnan, bet shammay omrim: bakkol nodrin chutz mibbishvua!
Tanna matnitin beneder, lehodiacha kochan devet shammay. tanna barayyta bishvua, lehodiacha kochan devet hillel.
Rav ashe amar, hachi katane, bet shammay omrim: en sheela bishvua, uvet hillel omrim: yesh sheela bishvua.
Mishna "hare netiot haellu korban im enan niktzatzot", "tallit zo korban im enah nisrefet" — yesh lahen pidyon. "hare netiot haellu korban ad sheyyikkatztzu", "tallit zo korban ad shettissaref" —
b: En lahem pidyon.
Gemara velitne "kedoshot veen kedoshot"! ayyeyde devae lemitna sefa "en lahem pidyon", tena name resha "yesh lahem pidyon".
Hechi nadar? amar ammemar: beomer "im enan niktzatzot hayyom", veavar hayyom velo niktzetzu. im ken lema li lememar? peshita! la tzericha kegon deikka zika nefisha.

Veha katane la gabbe tallit, vetallit lisrefa kayyma? [in] kegon deikka deleka. hacha name, deikka zika nefisha, vesalka datach demassek addateh dela mitnatzlan umishshum hachi ka nadar, ka mashma lan.

Hare netiot haellu korban kulei. uleolam? amar bar peda: pedaan — chozrot vekodshot, pedaan — chozrot vekodshot, ad sheyyikkatztzu. niktzetzu — podan paam achat vedayyo. veulla amar: kevan shenniktzetzu — shuv en podan.

a: Amar leh rav hamenuna: kedushsha shebbahen lehechan halcha? uma illu amar leishsha "hayyom at ishti ulemachar i at ishti", mi nafka bela get?!
Amar leh rava: mi ka medammet kedushshat damim likdushshat hagguf? kedushshat damim paka bichde, kedushshat hagguf la paka bichdi.

Amar leh abbaye: kedushshat hagguf la paka bichdi? vehatanya: "shor ze ola kol sheloshim yom, uleachar sheloshim yom shelamim" — kol sheloshim yom ola, leachar sheloshim yom shelamim. ammay? kedushshat hagguf ninhu, ufaka bichdi!
Hacha bemay askinan, deamar lidme.
I hachi, ema sefa: "leachar sheloshim yom ola, umeachshav shelamim". i amrat bishlama chada bikdushshat hagguf, vachada bikdushshat damim —
b: Hayeynu deitzterich leh letanna lemitne tarte. desalka datach amena: kedushshat hagguf la paka bichdi, kedushshat damim paka bichdi, ammetu lehachi tena tarte.
Ella i amrat idde veidde kedushshat damim, lema li lemitne tarte? hasheta yesh lomar: mikkedushsha chamura likdushsha kalla paka, mikkedushsha kalla likdushsha chamura tzericha lememar?!
Lema tehve teyuveta devar peda, deamar: la paka kedushsha bichdi?
Amar rav pappa: amar lach bar peda, hachi kaamar: im lo amar "meachshav shelamim" — leachar sheloshim yom ola have.
Midde dehave haomer leishsha: "hitkaddeshi li leachar sheloshim yom", dimkuddeshet veaf al pi shennitakkelu hammaot.
Peshita? la tzericha dahadar beh.
Hanicha leman deamar enah chozeret. ella leman deamar chozeret, may ikka lememar!
Afillu leman deamar hatam chozeret, hacha shane — daamirato legavoah kimsirato lehedyot.
Yetev rabbi avin verav yitzchak berabbi kammeh derabbi yirmeya, veka menamnem rabbi yirmeya, yatvi vekaamri: levar peda deamar pedaan chozrot vekodshot,

a: Tifshot devae rav hoshaya: hannoten shete ferutot leishsha veamar lah: "beachat hitkaddeshi li hayyom, uveachat hitkaddeshi li leachar sheagarshech", hachi name dehavu kiddushe.

Ittear behu rabbi yirmeya, amar lehu: may ka medammetun pedaan hu lifdaum acherim? hachi amar rabbi yochanan: pedaan hu — chozrot ukedoshot, pedaum acherim — en chozrot ukedoshot. veishsha kifdauha acherim damya.
Ittemar name, amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella sheppedaan hu, aval pedaum acherim — en chozrot ukedoshot.

Mishna hannoder miyyorde hayyam — muttar beyoshve hayyabbasha. miyyoshve hayyabbasha — asur miyyorde hayyam, sheyyorde hayyam bichlal yoshve hayyabbasha. lo keellu sheholchim meakko leyafo, ella bemi sheddarko lefaresh.

Gemara rav pappa verav acha bereh derav ika, chad matne aresha vechad matne assefa. man detane aresha, matne hachi: hannoder miyyorde hayyam — muttar beyoshve yabbasha, ha beyorde hayyam — asur, velo keellu
b: Haholchim meakko leyafo, dehalen yoshve hayyabbasha ninhu, ella mimmi sheddarkan lefaresh.
Uman dematne assefa, matne hachi: hannoder miyyoshve yabbasha — asur beyorde hayyam, velo beellu haholchim meakko leyafo bilvad, ella afillu bemi sheddarko lefaresh, hoil vesofo leyabbasha salek.
Mishna hannoder meroe hachamma — asur af bassomin, shello nitkavvevn ze ella lemi shehachamma roa otan.
Gemara may tama? middela kaamar "min haroin". leappoke dagim veubbarim.
Mishna hannoder mishshechore harosh — asur bakkerchin, uvaali sevot. umuttar bannashim uvakketannim, sheen nikrain "shechore harosh" ella anashim.
Gemara may tama — middela kaamar "mibbale sear".

Umuttar benashim uviktannim, sheen nikrain "shechore harosh" ella anashim. may tama — anashim zimnin demikkassu reshayyhu vezimnin demiggallu reshayyhu. aval nashim leolam mikkassu, uketannim leolam miggallu.
Mishna hannoder min hayyeludim — muttar benoladim. min hannoladim — asur min hayyeludim. rabbi meir mattir af bayyeludim. vachachamim omrim: lo nitkavvevn ze ella bemi sheddarko lehiuoled.
Gemara lerabbi meir vela mibbaya noladim. ella mimman asur?

Chassore michassera vehachi katane: hannoder min hayyeludim — muttar bannoladim, min hannoladim — asur bayyeludim, rabbi meir omer: af hannoder min hannoladim muttar bayyeludim, ki hechi denoder min hayyeludim muttar bannoladim.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: lememra denoladim" demityaylledan mashma? ella meatta "shene vanecha hannoladim lecha beeretz mitzrayim", hachi name deityayldan hu?

Veella may diylidu mashma, ella meatta dichtiv "hinne ven nolad levet david yoshiyyahu shemo", hachi name dahava? veha adayin menashshe lo ba? ella mashma hachi umashma hachi, uvindarim hallech achar leshon bene adam.
Vachachamim omrim, lo nitkavven ze ella mimmi sheddarko lehiuoled. leappoke may — leappoke dagim veofot.

a: Mishna hannoder mishshovte shabbat — asur beyisrael veasur bakkutim. meochle shum — asur beyisrael veasur bakkutim. meole yerushalayim — asur beyisrael umuttar bakkutim.
Gemara may "shovte shabbat"? illema mimmekayyeyme shabbat, may irya bakkutim? afillu goyim name! ella mimmetzuvvivym al hashshabbat.
I hachi, ema sefa: "meole yerushalayim" — asur beyisrael umuttar bakkutim, ammay? veha metzuvvivym ninhu!

Amar abbaye: metzuvvev veose katane. betarte bave kammayayta: yisrael vechutim — metzuvvivyn veosin, goyim hahu deavdi — osin veenam metzuvvivyn. beole yerushalayim: yisrael — metzuvvivyn veosin, kutim — metzuvvivyn veenam osin.
Mishna "kuvnnam sheeni nehene livne noach" — muttar beyisrael veasur beummot haolam.
Gemara veyisrael mi nafek mikkelal bene noach? kevan deikkaddash avraham, itkero al shemeh.
Mishna "sheeni nehene lezera avraham" — asur beyisrael umuttar beummot haolam.
Gemara vehaikka yishmael! "ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara" ketiv. vehaikka esav! "beyitzchak", velo kol yitzchak.

Mishna "sheeni nehene miyyisrael" — lokeach beyoter umocher befachot. "sheyyisrael nehenin li" — lokeach befachot umocher beyoter, veen shomin lo. "sheeni nehene lahen vehen li" — yehane leummot haolam.
Gemara amar shemuel: hallokeach keli min haumman levakkero veneenas beyado — chayyayv. alma kasavar hanaat lokeach hi.
Tenan: "sheeni nehene miyyisrael" — mocher befachot, aval shave beshave — la. vei hanaat lokeach hi — afillu shave beshave! matnitin bizvina dirme al appeh.
Im ken ema resha: lokeach beyoter. veod, ema sefa: "sheyyisrael nehenin li" — [lokeach befachot] umocher beyoter. vei bizvina dirme al appeh — afillu shave beshave!
Sefa bizvina charifa. i hachi lokeach befachot? afillu shave beshave! ella
b: Matnitin bizvina mitza, vedishmuel bizvina charifa.

Tanya kevateh dishmuel: hallokeach kelim min hattaggar leshaggeran levet chamiv, veamar lo: im mekabbelin otan mimmenni — ani noten lecha demehem, veim lav — ani noten lecha lefi tovat hanaa shebbahen. neensu bahalicha — chayyayv.
Bachazara — patur, mippene shehu kenose sachar.
Hahu safsira dishkal chamara lezabbone vela izzabban. bahade dahadar, ittenis chamra, chayyeyveh rav nachman leshallome. etiveh rava lerav nachman: neensu bahalicha chayyayv, bachazara patur.
Amar leh: chazara desafsira — holacha hi. deillu mashkach lezabbone — afillu abbava deveteh mi la mezabben leh?
Mishna "kuvnnam sheani nehene laarelim" — muttar bearle yisrael, veasur bemule ummot haolam.

"Sheani nehene lammulim" — asur bearle yisrael, umuttar bemule ummot haolam. sheen haorla keruya ella leshem ummot haolam, shenneemar: "ki chol haggoyim arelim vechol bet yisrael arle lev". veomer: "vehaya happelishti hearel hazze". veomer: "pen tismachna benot pelishtim pen taalozna benot haarelim".
Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: meusa hi haorla, shennitgannu bah reshaim shenneemar: "ki chol haggoyim arelim". rabbi yishmael omer: gedola mila, shennichretu aleha shelosh esre beritot.
Rabbi yose omer: gedola mila sheddocha et hashshabbat chamura.
Rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: gedola mila — shello nitla lo lemoshe hatztzaddik aleha melo shaa.
Rabbi nechemya omer: gedola mila — sheddocha et hannegaim. rabbi omer: gedola mila, shekkol hammitzvot sheasa avraham avinu lo nikra shalem ad shemmal, shenneemar: "hithallech lefanay vehye tamim".
Davar acher: gedola mila — sheilmale hi, lo bara hakkadosh baruch hu et olamo, shenneemar: "ko amar Adonai im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti".
Gemara tanya, rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: gedola mila, shekkol zechiyyot sheasa moshe rabbenu lo amdu lo keshennitrashshel min hammila, shenneemar: "vayyifgeshehu Adonai vayvakkesh hamito".

Amar rabbi: chas veshalom shemmoshe rabbenu nitrashshel min hammila, ella kach amar: amul veetze — sakkana hi, shenneemar: "vayhi vayyom hashshelishi bihyotam koavim vegomer". amul veeshhe shelosha yamim, hakkadosh baruch hu amar li "lech shuv mitzrayim". ella mippene ma neenash moshe —

a: Mippene shennitassek bammalon techilla, shenneemar "vayhi badderech bammalon".
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: lo lemoshe rabbenu bikkesh satan laharog, ella leoto tinok, shenneemar: "ki chatan damim atta li", tze uree mi karuy chatan — heve omer ze hattinok.

Daresh rabbi yehuda bar bizna: beshaa shennitrashshel moshe rabbenu min hammila, bau "af" vechema" uvelauhu, velo shiyyeyru mimmennu ella raglav. miyyad "vattikkach tzippora tzor vattichrot et orlat benah", miyyad "vayyiref mimmennu".

Beotah shaa bikkesh moshe rabbenu lehorgan, shenneemar: "heref meaf vaazov chema". veyesh omrim: lechema harago, shenneemar: "chema en li". vehachtiv: "ki yagorti mippene haaf vehachema"! tere chema havo. veibbaet ema: guneda dechema.

Tanya rabbi omer: gedola mila, sheen lach mi shennitassek bemitzvot keavraham avinu, velo nikra tamim ella al shem mila, shenneemar: "hithallech lefanay vehye tamim", uchetiv: "veettena veriti beni uvenecha".

Davar acher: gedola mila, sheshshekula keneged kol hammitzvot shebbattora, shenneemar: "ki al pi haddevarim haelle vegomer", davar acher: gedola mila, sheilmale mila lo nitkayyeymu shamayim vaaretz, shenneemar: "im lo beriti yomam valayla vegomer".
Ufeliga derabbi eliezer, deamar rabbi eliezer: gedola tora, sheilmale tora lo nitkayyeymu shamayim vaaretz, shenneemar: "im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti vegomer".

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: beshaa sheamar lo hakkadosh baruch hu leavraham avinu "hithallech lefanay vehye tamim" achazattu reada. amar: shemma yesh bi davar megunne. kevan sheamar lo: "veettena veriti beni uvenecha", nitkarra dato.
"Vayyotze oto hachutza", amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, histakkalti bammazzal shelli veen li ella ben echad. amar lo: tze meitztagninut shellecha, en mazzal leyisrael.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: kol hametammem atzmo — hakkadosh baruch hu mittammem immo, shenneemar: "im chasid titchassad im gibbor tamim tittammam".
Amar rabbi hoshaya: kol hametammem atzmo — shaa omedet lo, shenneemar: "hithallech lefanay vehye tamim", uchetiv: "vehayita leav hamon goyim".
Amar rabbi: kol hamenachesh — lo nachash, shenneemar: "ki lo nachash beyaakov". veha belamed alef ketiv! ella mishshum midda keneged midda.

Tane ahava bereh derabbi zera: kol adam sheeno menachesh, machnisin oto bimchitza sheafillu malache hashsharet en yecholin likkanes betochah, shenneemar: "ki lo nachash beyaakov velo kesem beyisrael vegomer".

Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar: mippene ma neenash avraham avinu venishtabedu banav lemitzrayim matayim veeser shanim — mippene sheasa angaryay betalmide chachamim, shenneemar: "vayyarek et chanichav yelide veto".

Ushemuel amar: mippene shehifriz al middotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "bamma eda ki irashenna". verabbi yochanan amar: shehifrish bene adam millehikkanes tachat kanfe hashshechina, shenneemar: "ten li hannefesh veharchush kach lach".
"Vayyarek et chanichav yelide veto", rav amar: shehorikan battora. ushemuel amar: shehorikan bezahav.
"Shemona asar ushelosh meot", amar rabbi amme bar abba: eliezer keneged kullam. ikka deamri: eliezer hu, dechushebaneh hachi have.
Veamar rabbi amme bar abba: ben shalosh shanim hikkir avraham et boro, shenneemar: "ekev asher shama avraham bekoli" — chushebaneh mea veshivin uteren.
Veamar rame bar abba:
b: "Hassatan" bechushebaneh telat mea veshittin vearbea. veamar rame bar abba: ketiv "avram", uchetiv "avraham". battechilla himlicho hakkadosh baruch hu al matayim vearbaim ushelosha evarim, ulevassof himlicho al matayim vearbaim ushemone evarim,
Ellu hen: shete enayim, ushete oznayim, verosh haggeviyyay.

Veamar rame bar abba, may dichtiv: "ir ketanna vaanashim vegomer". "ir ketanna" — ze hagguf, "vaanashim bah meat" — ellu evarim, "uva eleha melech gadol vesavav otah" — ze yetzer hara, "uvana aleha metzodim vacharamim" — ellu avonot,

"Umatza vah ish misken vechacham" — ze yetzer tov, "umillat hu et hair bechochmato" — zo teshuva umaasim tovim. "veadam lo zachar et haish hammisken hahu" — devishat yetzer hara let demiddechar leh leyetzer tov.

"Hachochma taoz lechacham measara shallitim". "hachochma taoz lechacham" — zo teshuva umaasim tovim, "measara shallitim" — shete enayim, ushete oznayim, ushete yadayim, ushete raglayim, verosh haggeviyyay, ufe.

Amar rabbi zecharya mishshum rabbi yishmael: bikkesh hakkadosh baruch hu lehotzi kehunna mishshem, shenneemar: "vehu chohen leel elyon". kevan shehikdim birkat avraham levirkat hammakom — hotziah meavraham.

Shenneemar: "vayvarchehu vayyomar baruch avram leel elyon kone shamayim vaaretz uvaruch el elyon". amar lo avraham: vechi makdimin birkat eved levirkat kono? miyyad netanah leavraham, shenneemar: "neum Adonai ladoni shev limini ad ashit oyvecha hadom leraglecha", uvatreh ketiv: "nishba Adonai velo yinnachem atta chohen leolam al divrati malki tzedek". al dibburo shel malki tzedek.
Vehayeynu dichtiv "vehu chohen leel elyon": hu kohen, veen zaro kohen.
Haderan alach arbaa nedarim
En ben hammuddar hanaa mechavero lammuddar hemennu maachol ella derisat haregel vechelim sheen osin bahem ochel nefesh.
Hammuddar maachol mechavero lo yashilennu nafa uchevara verechayim vetannur, aval mashil lo chaluk vetabbaat vetallit unezamim.
Gemara man tena? amar rav adda bar ahava: rabbi eliezer hi, detanya rabbi eliezer omer: afillu vittur asur bemuddar hanaa.
Hammuddar maachol mechavero lo yashilennu vechulei.

a: Veha min maachol nadar! amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: beomer "hanaat maachalcha alay".
Ema shello yilos chittin veyitten al makkato! amar rava: beomer "hanaa hammevia lide maachalcha alay".

Amar rav pappa: sak lehavi perot, vachamor lehavi alav perot, vaafillu tzanna bealma, hanaa hammevia lide maachol hu. bae rav pappa: sus lirkov alav vetabbaat leraot bah, mahu? mifsak umezal beareh, may?
Ta shema: aval mashil lo chaluk vetallit nezamim vetabbaot. hechi dame? illema shello leraot bahen, tzericha lememar? ella lav, afillu leraot bahen, vekatane "mashilo"!
La, leolam shello leraot, veayyeyde dekatane resha "lo yashilennu", tena sefa "mashilo".
Mishna vechol davar sheen osin bo ochel nefesh, makom shemmaskirin keyotze bahen — asur.
Gemara mikkelal deresha, af al pi sheen maskirin. man tanna? amar rav adda bar ahava: rabbi eliezer hi.
Mishna hammuddar hanaa mechavero, shokel lo et shiklo uforea et chovo, umachazir lo et avedato. makom shennotlin aleha sachar — tippol hanaa lahekdesh.
Gemara alma avroche ari bealma hu, ushere.
Man tanna? amar rav hoshaya: zo
b: Divre chanan hi.
Rava amar: afillu tema divre hakkol, gabbe muddar hanaa deyahev al menat shello lifroa.
May chanan? ditnan: mi shehalach limdinat hayyam, veamad echad ufirnes et ishto. chanan amar: ibbed et meotav.

Nechleku alav bene kohanim gedolim, veamru: yishshava kamma hotzi, veyittol. amar rabbi dosa ben harekinas kedivrehem. amar rabbi yochanan ben zakkay: yafe amar chanan, hinniach meotav al keren hatztzevi.
Rava la amar kerav hoshaya, deka mokem lah lematnitin kedivre hakkol. rav hoshaya la amar kerava, gezera shello lippara mishshum lippara.

Machazir lo et avedato. peligi ba rabbi amme verabbi assi, chad amar: lo shanu ella beshennichse machzir asurin al baal aveda, dechi mahdar leh — middaam denafsheh ka mahdar leh. aval nichse baal aveda asurin al machzir — la ka mahdar leh, deka mehanne leh peruta derav yosef.
Vechad amar: afillu nichse baal aveda asurin al machzir mahdar leh, umishshum peruta derav yosef la shechiach.

a: Tenan: makom shennotlin aleha sachar — tippol hanaa lahekdesh. bishlama leman deamar afillu beshennichse baal aveda asurim al machzir name mahdar — hayeynu dekatane makom shennotlin aleha sachar tippol hanaa lahekdesh.
Ella leman deamar keshennichse baal aveda asurim al machzir la mahdar, ammay tippol hanaa lahekdesh?
Achada katane.

Ikka dematne la behay lishshana: peligi ba rabbi amme verabbi assi. chad amar: lo shanu ella beshennichse baal aveda asurin al machzir, umishshum peruta derav yosef la shechiach. aval nichse machzir asurim al baal aveda — la mahdar leh, mishshum deka mehanne leh.
Vechad amar: afillu nichse machzir asurim al baal aveda — muttar. dechi mahdar leh — midde denafsheh kamahdar leh.
Tenan: makom shennotlin aleha sachar — tippol hanaa lahekdesh. bishlama leman deamar afillu beshennichse machzir asurim al baal aveda mahdar — hayeynu dimtaretz makom.
Ella leman deamar beshennichse machzir asurin, vela mahdar, hechi metaretz makom? kashya.
b: Amar rava: hayta lefanav kikkar shel hefker, veamar: "kikkar zo hekdesh", netalah leochlah — maal lefi kullah. lehorisha levanav — maal lefi tovat hanaa shebbah.
Bea minneh rav chiyyay bar avin merava: "kikkari alecha" unetanah lo bemattana, mahu? "kikkari" amar lo, ki iteh birshuteh hu deasur. o dilma "alecha" amar leh, illaveh shavviteh hekdesh?
Amar leh: peshita deaf al gav deyahava leh bemattana — asur. ella "kikkari alecha" leappoke may? lav leappoke dei ganva minneh mignav? amar leh: la, leappoke dei azmeneh ala.

a: Etiveh, amar lo: "hasheileni paratcha", amar lo: "kuvnnam para sheani kanuy lach", "nechasay alecha im yesh li para ella zo". "hasheileni kardummecha", amar lo: "kuvnnam kardom sheyyesh li sheani kanuy", "nechasay alay im yesh li kardom ella ze", venimtza sheyyesh lo — bechayyav asur, met o shennittena lo bemattana — hare ze muttar.
Amar rav acha bereh derav ika: shennittena lo al yede acher.
Amar rav ashe: dayka name dekatane "shennittena lo", vela katane "shennetanah lo".
Bea minneh rava merav nachman: yesh meila bekunnamot, o la?
Amar leh, tenetuha: mekom shennotlin aleha sachar — tippol hanaa lahekdesh. lememra ki hekdesh, ma hekdesh yesh bo meila — af kunnamot yesh bahen meila.

Ketannae: "kuvnnam kikkar zo hekdesh" vaachalah, ben hu uven chavero — maal, lefichach yesh lah pidyon. "kikkar zo alay lehekdesh" vaachalah, hu — maal, chavero — lo maal. lefichach en lah pidyon. divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: ben kach uven kach lo maal, lefi sheen meila bekunnamot.

Amar leh rav acha bereh derav avya lerav ashe: "kikkari alecha" unetanah lo bemattana, mi maal? limol noten — ha la asira aleh! limol mekabbel — yachol deamar: hettera beeti, issura la beeti. amar leh: mekabbel maal lichsheyyotzi, shekkol hammotzi meot hekdesh lechullin, kesavur shel chullin hu — moel. af ze — moel.
b: Mishna vetorem et terumato umaserotav ledato, umakriv alav kinne zavin, kinne zavot, kinne yoldot, chattaot vaashamot. umelammedo midrash halachot veaggadot, aval lo yelammedennu mikra. aval melammed hu et banav veet benotav mikra.

Gemara ibbaya lehu: hane kahane, sheluche didan havu, o sheluche dishmayya? lemay nafka minna — lemuddar hanaa. i amrat dishluche didan havu, ha mehanne leh veasur. vei amrat sheluche dishmayya — shere. may?
Ta shema, ditnan: makriv alav kinne zavin kulei. i amrat sheluche didan, ka mehanne leh?

Velitamaych, litne: makriv alav korbanot! ella, mechussere chappara shane. deamar rabbi yochanan: hakkol tzerichin daat, chutz mimmechussere chappara. shehare adam mevi korban al banav veal benotav hakketannim, shenneemar: "zot torat hazzav", ben gadol ben katan.

Ella meatta, lerabbi yochanan "zot torat hayyoledet vegomer", ben ketanna uven gedola? ketanna bat leda hi?! veha tane rav bivi kammeh derav nachman: shalosh nashim meshammeshot bemoch: ketanna umeubberet umenika. ketanna — shemma titabber vetamut.
Hahi "zot torat hayyoledet", ben pikkachat ben shota, shekken adam mevi korban al ishto shota,
Kedivre rabbi yehuda. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: adam mevi korban ashir al ishto, vechol korbanot shechayyevet,
Shekkach kotev lah: veachrayut deit lich alay min kadmat dena.
